summary: Iteration 3 backend-only testing of Gestor360. Added /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3.py (27 tests) covering Client structured address + IE persistence (POST/GET/PUT), Company IE (PUT/GET), Document payments persistence for all 6 methods incl. 12x credito, empty-description lines, the NEW PUT /api/documents/{id} (partial update of lines/payments/notes/client_id, metadata preservation, 400 invalid client, 404 unknown doc, 401 unauth, empty-body no-op), PDF rendering (200 + application/pdf + %PDF) for a doc with payments and structured client address, convert orcamento->venda, and regression on /clients /products /documents /stats /company /. Ran full suite (backend_test.py + test_iteration3.py): 46 passed, 1 failed.

minor.issue: convert_document builds new_doc without a 'payments' key, so the created venda document has no payments field at all (not even []). GET /api/documents/{id} for a converted venda therefore omits 'payments', which can break the frontend edit-mode (?id=) payment tab that expects the array. Fix: add 'payments': src.get('payments', []) (or []) in the new_doc dict.
No existence check — updating a non-existent client id silently returns 200 with the echoed payload instead of 404. Also returns the request payload rather than the persisted DB document.
No validation that payment amounts sum to document total and no bound on installments (accepts installments > 12 or 0/negative for credito). Business rule enforcement is frontend-only.

action_items: Add 'payments': src.get('payments', []) to the new_doc built in convert_document so converted vendas always expose the payments array.
Optional: return 404 from PUT /api/clients/{id} when the client does not exist and return the persisted document.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 858 lines — split into routers (auth, clients, products, documents, pdf) for maintainability.

convert_document constructs the venda dict manually instead of using the Document model, which is exactly why the new 'payments' field was missed; build it via Document(...).model_dump() to stay in sync with the model.

PaymentPart.method is a plain str, not a Literal/Enum — arbitrary methods like 'bitcoin' are accepted and silently stored (PDF then prints the raw value). Tighten to Literal['pix','dinheiro','credito','debito','boleto','transferencia'].
PaymentPart.installments has no ge=1/le=12 constraint despite the 1-12 parcelas requirement.
seed_data_creation: All test data prefixed TEST_ (clients, products, documents) and deleted in module teardown; company IE restored to its original value after the IE test.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suites live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (iteration 2) and /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3.py (iteration 3). Run with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v`. Note pytest.ini uses xdist, so tests must generate unique product codes (uuid suffix) to avoid duplicate-code 400s across workers. Only known open failure: TestConvertWithPayments::test_converted_venda_has_payments_key (convert omits payments key). Frontend (QuoteBuilder edit mode, ViaCEP, payment tab, client/product suggestion dropdowns) has NOT been tested yet.
rca_of_the_issue: convert_document (server.py ~line 525) hand-builds the new venda dict with a fixed set of keys and was not updated when PaymentPart/payments was added to the Document model. Reproduce: create an orcamento with payments, POST /api/documents/{id}/convert, then GET the new doc id — response has no 'payments' key. Mitigation: include payments (copied or empty list) or construct via the Document pydantic model.
